e.title: 国际精算协会（IAA）
e.summary: 全球精算业伞形组织：成员目录、精算标准（ISAP）、气候与可持续/教育等专业委员会
e.summary_en: Global umbrella body for the actuarial profession: member directories, actuarial standards (ISAPs), and committees on climate & sustainability, education and more
e.summary_hk: 全球精算業傘形組織：成員目錄、精算標準（ISAP）、氣候與可持續/教育等專業委員會
e.body: 国际精算协会（International Actuarial Association, IAA，`actuaries.org`）是**全球精算业的伞形组织**——各国精算协会是其 Full Member，个人与机构可作 Associate Member。网站可核实的实用栏目包括：**Full / Associate Member 目录**（查任一国家精算学会的官方对口）、**Council & Statutory Committees**、**Actuarial Standards**（国际精算实务准则 ISAP 的制定主体）、**Climate & Sustainability** 委员会、**Education** 委员会、**ADVANCE** 等。此外 IAA 下设若干**专业分会（Sections）**，其中与本 wiki 主题最相关的两个是 **ASTIN（非寿险）** 与 **AFIR-ERM（金融风险与企业风险管理）**，各自出版期刊并举办 Section Colloquia。对 RIAA：这是判断「**某个国家的精算资格与标准是谁说了算、能否互认**」的顶层入口——例如把 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]] 等区域学会放回 IAA 框架下，就能看清资格互认与标准趋同的路径；气候与可持续委员会的存在本身也说明 ESG 已进入精算标准议程（对照 [[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-governance]]）；研究会话与研究资源见 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[actuarialdatascience]]；适合作职业路径规划、资格对比与行业标准方向。
e.body_en: The International Actuarial Association (IAA, `actuaries.org`) is **the global umbrella body for the actuarial profession** — national actuarial associations are Full Members, while individuals and institutions may join as Associate Members. Verifiable practical sections include: the **Full / Associate Member directories** (to find the official counterpart association in any country), **Council & Statutory Committees**, the **Actuarial Standards** committee (which develops the ISAPs, International Standards of Actuarial Practice), the **Climate & Sustainability** committee, the **Education** committee and **ADVANCE**. The IAA also hosts **Sections**, of which the two most relevant to this wiki are **ASTIN (non-life)** and **AFIR-ERM (financial risks and enterprise risk management)**, each publishing a journal and running Section Colloquia. For RIAA: the top-level entry point for "**who sets actuarial qualifications and standards in a given country, and are they mutually recognised**" — placing regional bodies such as [[china-actuarial-association]], [[ashk]], [[actuaries-institute]] and [[singapore-actuarial-society]] inside the IAA framework clarifies the paths of mutual recognition and standards convergence; the existence of a climate & sustainability committee also shows ESG has entered the actuarial standards agenda (compare [[geneva-association]] and [[insurance-governance]]); for research sessions and resources see [[cas-research-tools]] and [[actuarialdatascience]]; suits career-path planning, qualification comparison and standards work.
e.body_hk: 國際精算協會（International Actuarial Association, IAA，`actuaries.org`）是**全球精算業的傘形組織**——各國精算協會是其 Full Member，個人與機構可作 Associate Member。網站可核實的實用欄目包括：**Full / Associate Member 目錄**、**Council & Statutory Committees**、**Actuarial Standards**（國際精算實務準則 ISAP 的制定主體）、**Climate & Sustainability** 委員會、**Education** 委員會、**ADVANCE** 等。此外 IAA 下設若干**專業分會（Sections）**，其中與本 wiki 主題最相關的兩個是 **ASTIN（非壽險）** 與 **AFIR-ERM（金融風險與企業風險管理）**。對 RIAA：這是判斷「**某個國家的精算資格與標準是誰說了算、能否互認**」的頂層入口——把 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]] 等區域學會放回 IAA 框架下，就能看清資格互認與標準趨同的路徑；適合作職業路徑規劃、資格對比與行業標準方向。
